title: Analytics
description: Clicks and QR scans across this workspace. Every filter is in the address, so a view can be shared or bookmarked.
noActivity: No clicks or scans in this period.
clamped: Data before {date} is outside your plan's analytics window.

links.title: Links
links.description: Clicks and scans per short link.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Where visitors were when they clicked or scanned.

cities.title: Cities
cities.description: The nearest city we could place each visit in.

referrers.title: Referrers
referrers.description: The site a visit came from. Direct means no referring site, such as a typed address, an app or a QR scan.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Desktop, mobile, tablet and other device types.

browsers.title: Browsers
browsers.description: The browser each visit was made with.

os.title: Operating systems
os.description: The operating system each visit was made on.

utm-source.title: UTM sources
utm-source.description: The utm_source tag of tagged links, such as newsletter or facebook.

utm-medium.title: UTM mediums
utm-medium.description: The utm_medium tag of tagged links, such as email or cpc.

utm-campaign.title: UTM campaigns
utm-campaign.description: The utm_campaign tag of tagged links.
